description: This file declares classes and functions for controlling GPIO pins within the EFI-related subsystem of an automotive ECU firmware. It includes class definitions for various output pins, functions for initialization, state management, and hardware interactions specific to the EFI system.

classes.name: OutputPin
classes.description: Represents a single output GPIO pin, with methods for initialization, setting value, toggling, and querying its state.

classes.name: NamedOutputPin
classes.description: A subclass of OutputPin that adds a name for identification and methods to set the pin high or low, and to stop the pin.

classes.name: InjectorOutputPin
classes.description: Extends NamedOutputPin with additional fields for injector control, including schedule timing and state management flags.

classes.name: IgnitionOutputPin
classes.description: Extends NamedOutputPin to include ignition-specific attributes like fall signal ID and order status.

classes.name: EnginePins
classes.description: Aggregates all engine-related GPIO pins, both output pins and arrays of injectors and coils, with methods for managing their lifecycle.

methods.name: initPin
methods.description: Initializes an output pin with a message, pin identifier, and output mode.

methods.name: unregisterOutput
methods.description: Dissociates a pin from its current configuration, unregistering it.

methods.name: isInitialized
methods.description: Returns whether the pin has been initialized.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the logic level (high or low) of the pin.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the current logic state of the pin.

methods.name: getLogicValue
methods.description: Returns the current logical value of the pin.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the pin operation, returning true if the pin was stopped.

methods.name: setHigh
methods.description: Sets the pin to a high logic level.

methods.name: setLow
methods.description: Sets the pin to a low logic level.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the state of injector or ignition pins.
